name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $92 on 12 Nov, down 13% on the month as US strikes on Iran pause; Hormuz still largely shut
state: Brent was near $91.9 early on 12 Nov, 13% lower on the month and 6.6% lower on the week, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). Prices have eased since US officials said on 9–10 Nov that new strikes on Iran were unnecessary, but Iran said on 11 Nov that Hormuz stays shut until its conditions are met (Al Jazeera). No new outage above 2 mb/d was confirmed this run.
for_you: Fuel prices tend to follow Brent with a lag of a few weeks; the monthly fall may ease pump prices, but supply through Hormuz remains disrupted.

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran denies talks with US, says Hormuz will stay shut until demands are met

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
